1. `listTools()` should return a list containing the `events_list` tool with:
   - `name`: 'events_list'

```javascript
import events from './events.json' with {type: 'json'};

function encodeCursor(index) {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({i: index}), 'utf8').toString('base64');
}

function decodeCursor(cursor) {
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(cursor, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  }
  if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object' || typeof parsed.i !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(parsed.i) || parsed.i < 0 || parsed.i >= events.length) {
    throw new Error('Invalid cursor');
  }
  return parsed.i;
}

export async function listTools() {
  return [{
    name: 'events_list',
    description: '...',
    inputSchema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        cursor: {type: 'string'},
        page_size: {type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: 3}
      },
      additionalProperties: false,
      required: []
    }
  }];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'events_list') throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  
  // Validate input
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments');
  }
  
  const allowedKeys = new Set(['cursor', 'page_size']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowedKeys.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  let pageSize = 2;
  if ('page_size' in args) {
    const v = args.page_size;
    if (typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(v) || v < 1 || v > 3) {
      throw new Error('page_size must be an integer between 1 and 3');
    }
    pageSize = v;
  }
  
  let start = 0;
  if ('cursor' in args) {
    if (typeof args.cursor !== 'string') {
      throw new Error('cursor must be a string');
    }
    start = decodeCursor(args.cursor);
  }
  
  const end = Math.min(start + pageSize, events.length);
  const page = events.slice(start, end);
  const hasMore = end < events.length;
  
  const response = {
    events: page
  };
  if (hasMore) {
    response.next_cursor = encodeCursor(end);
  }
  
  return {
    content: [{type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(response)}]
  };
}
```
